translation: [Note] This speaks of when the body is injured and much blood comes out, and when one is struck by wind and cold—these are of the category of tetanus (破傷風). Or because of a fall, it is not necessary that blood comes out, but the four limbs are slack and do not gather; all are called body lassitude. Guanyuan is the name of a point of the Ren (任) vessel; moreover, the vessels of foot Yangming and Taiyin all knot here, hence it is called the three crossings.
